integrity: Complete analytic proof and reproducible independent exact finite checks are supplied; not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Finite n-gonal antiprisms with n>=3, classical spin-1/2 values +/-1, equal positive antiferromagnetic coupling, ground states at zero field. No all-field phase diagram, finite-temperature susceptibility or thermodynamic phase transition; the thermal limit precedes the size limit. Priority relative to finite-range Ising transfer-matrix tabulations remains provisional.
title: Parity-split ground-state magnetization and Curie response on Ising antiprisms
